result.title: Zhengrong-Spatial-Aware 1.0: Advancing 3D Multimodal Intelligence
result.summary: This report presents the implementation and validation of two end-to-end multimodal adaptation pipelines for 3D-aware visual question answering on a custom spatial dataset. The first pipeline fine-tunes HiSpatial-3B, which augments RGB observations with metric-scale 3D point maps; the second adapts Qwen3-VL through memory-efficient QLoRA-based supervised fine-tuning. The completed engineering stack covers dataset conversion, image-annotation alignment, monocular geometry preprocessing, instruction construction, mixed-domain training, checkpoint management, batch inference, and automated evaluation. On the target spatial benchmark, HiSpatial adaptation increases overall accuracy from 1.73% before fine-tuning to 79.89% at 3,600 steps. On a separately collected styled split, accuracy improves from 14.9% to 55.1%, indicating transfer beyond the original training set. The Qwen3-VL pipeline is likewise implemented end-to-end for both 8B- and 32B-scale models using mixed-domain QLoRA adaptation. The resulting accuracy improves from 20.74% to 45.27% for Qwen3-VL-8B and from 30.79% to 47.60% for Qwen3-VL-32B. Together, these results establish two complementary and reproducible adaptation pipelines for geometry-aware and general-purpose multimodal spatial reasoning. These results establish a reproducible engineering foundation for subsequent work on metric 3D reasoning, spatial grounding, and domain-adapted multimodal systems, while also identifying training-data composition as a central factor in preserving general multimodal capability during specialization.

AI.brief_summary: 该技术报告构建并验证了两条 3D 感知空间 VQA 的端到端适配流程：基于 3D 点图增强的 HiSpatial-3B 微调，以及 Qwen3-VL 的 QLoRA 有监督微调，并在自建空间基准上报告精度提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 属工程化领域适配与刷分报告，点图仅作为输入模态而非内部推理状态，未涉及 latent 状态生成、证据筛选或停止决策；混合域数据配比虽提及泛化保持，但线索过于笼统，缺少可核查的推理机制联系。
